# BB00406 {.unnumbered}

Unto God belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been powerful over all things.

Unto God belongeth the splendour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-glorious, all-glorious.

Unto God belongeth the effulgence of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-luminous, all-luminous.

Unto God belongeth the radiance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-illuminating, all-illuminating.

Unto God belongeth the appointed share of pearls: it is taken by the Prophet and by those who, from His presence, are witnesses, and they expend it upon those of the seed of the Prophet and the Imams, that haply they may not be constrained to ask of men.

Unto God belongeth the majesty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, majestic, majestic.

Unto God belongeth the beauty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, beautiful, beautiful.

Unto God belongeth the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a light all-luminous.

Unto God belongeth all greatness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is, in very truth, most great, most great.

Unto God belongeth all mercy in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is, in very truth, merciful, merciful.

Unto God belongeth all wisdom in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, wise, wise.

Unto God belongeth all might in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, mighty, mighty.

Unto God belongeth the whole of the Will in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is He Who bringeth into being and Who bringeth back again.

Unto God belongeth the whole of the Purpose in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, One Who willeth what He willeth.

Unto God belongeth the measure of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a measure all-powerful.

Unto God belongeth the decree of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a decree tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the leave and permission (for all that is in) the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a leave near at hand.

Unto God belongeth whatsoever is most exalted and wondrous in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of an origination all-glorious.

Unto God belong the Books of heaven and earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the knowledge of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-knowing, all-knowing.

Unto God belongeth all power in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, all-powerful, all-powerful.

Unto God belongeth the utterance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, well-pleased, well-pleased.

Unto God belong the entreaties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Well-Beloved, the Well-Beloved.

Unto God belongeth the honour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of an honour tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, a Sovereign, Most Great.

Unto God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a dominion immense.

Unto God belongeth the exaltation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, Most High, Most High.

Unto God belong the signs of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the All-Sustaining, the All-Sustaining.

Unto God belongeth the bounty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a bounty from time immemorial.

Unto God belong the states and conditions of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of an estate impregnable.

Unto God belongeth the realm of might (jabarut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, the Possessor of a power tremendous.
